nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf; the core token ledger mutated unchecked in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender]; arbitrary allowances set in approve and constructor, decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; sole authority for delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
tradeAddress whitelist address used inside ensure to bypass sale conditions; writable by owner via setTradeAddress.
Private mapping(address=>bool) canSale; set true by _mints and grants a whitelist bypass of ensure/condition.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) _onSaleNum; per-address counter incremented in transferFrom and checked in condition against _saleNum.
Private uint256 _saleNum; maximum number of sales allowed per address, set in init.
Private uint256 _minSale; minimum transfer value enforced by condition, set in init.
Private uint256 _maxSale; maximum transfer value enforced by condition, set in init.
Public totalSupply; assigned once in the constructor as supply scaled by decimals.
Public constant decimals = 18 used to scale mint and init amounts.
Constant address UNI (0x7a25...488D) hard-coded as a whitelisted sender in ensure.
Public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that forwards straight to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value); decrements allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure.
Public payable approve(address _spender, uint _value); writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-allowance race protection.
Internal view ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) implementing the whitelist bypass (owner, UNI, _UNI, tradeAddress, canSale) and otherwise requiring condition.
Internal view condition(address _from, uint _value) enforcing _saleNum per-address limits and _minSale/_maxSale value bounds.
Public payable delegate(address a, bytes b); owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied target - a critical hijack primitive.
Public _mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and marks canSale[spender]=true; gated only by a hard-coded address comparison.
Public init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken); owner-gated setter for _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value); owner-gated loop that computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked math and credits balances.
Public owner-gated setTradeAddress(address addr) that overwrites the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure pairFor(factory, tokenA, tokenB) that re-derives the Uniswap pair address via keccak256 for the ensure whitelist check.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner = msg.sender, the deployer balance and an infinite allowance to the UNI router.
msg.sender - attacker controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowance ownership and transfer authorisation.
a.delegatecall(b) inside delegate(); executes arbitrary attacker supplied bytecode in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked underflow: balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom (Solidity 0.5 has no built-in overflow checks).
Unchecked underflow: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom.
Unchecked overflow: total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Unchecked overflow: balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom (and the equivalent per-recipient credit in batchSend).
Parameter _from of transferFrom/ensure: the sender whose balance and allowance are debited.
Parameter _to of transfer/transferFrom: the recipient credited by the unchecked addition.
Parameter _value of transfer/transferFrom/approve/batchSend: the attacker controllable amount used in every unchecked arithmetic operation and in condition.
Parameter _spender of approve: the address granted allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Parameter a of delegate: the target contract address passed to the raw delegatecall.
Parameter b of delegate: the attacker supplied calldata executed via delegatecall.
Parameter addedValue of _mints: amount scaled by decimals and written directly into balanceOf[spender].
Parameter _tos of batchSend: recipient array whose length multiplies _value in the unchecked total computation.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress: replacement value for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Local _UNI in ensure: the computed pairFor(factory, WETH, address(this)) address compared against _from.
Local total in batchSend: the product _value * _tos.length computed with unchecked arithmetic.
Local loop index i in batchSend iterating over the recipient array.
